# Pinterest Predicts 2026: The top trends you need to know

Pinterest's 2026 trend forecast just landed. 21 predictions, 88% accuracy, and cabbage is somehow involved.

[David Allegretti](https://elements.envato.com/learn/author/dallegretti)13min read
23 Dec 2025

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-2-2.png)

Pinterest knows what you’ll want for dinner next autumn. And what color you’ll paint your bedroom. And which holiday destination will end up on your mood board six months from now.

That sounds like a bold claim, but the platform’s annual trend report, [Pinterest Predicts](https://business.pinterest.com/en-gb/pinterest-predicts/), has an 88% accuracy rate over the past six years. The 2026 edition was released this month, featuring 21 emerging trends across fashion, beauty, interiors, food, and travel, each identified through billions of search queries from approximately 600 million monthly users.

Because people come to Pinterest to plan (weddings, renovations, outfits, meals), the platform captures intent signals months (or even years) before they translate into purchases and behavior. That forward-looking data makes Pinterest Predicts genuinely useful for creatives, marketers, and brands trying to get ahead of demand, rather than react to it.

The commercial impact is real. Last year’s Pickle Fix prediction saw searches for “pickle nails” grow 85% and outbound clicks for pickle seasoning explode by 835%. Checkouts on Pinterest Predicts 2025-related content increased 68% year over year. Trends identified here consistently move into retail, campaigns, and broader culture.

This year’s report reveals an overarching theme worth paying attention to: trend fatigue. Gen Z, who drive 67% of the 2026 predictions, are exhausted by the pressure to keep up. The trends emerging now prioritize comfort, personal expression, and escape over status signaling and FOMO. Understanding that shift matters as much as knowing which color palette is rising.

## **Pinterest Predicts 2026: The biggest trends**

Now here’s the part you came for.

Three currents run beneath the surface of this year’s predictions: nostalgia evolving into reclamation, identity curation replacing trend-following, and escapism as emotional recharge. Here’s what’s set to define the year ahead.

### **Gimme Gummy**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/gimme-gummy.png)

**What it is:** A tactile, playful aesthetic defined by rubbery textures, jelly-like finishes, and bouncy, squishy everything. Think bendy phone cases, elastic cheek tints, rubberized nail art, and [3D](https://elements.envato.com/learn/3d-design-trends) jewelry that looks good enough to chew.

**Why it’s trending:** Gen Z and Millennials are gravitating toward sensory experiences with an almost ASMR quality. The gummy aesthetic taps into childhood nostalgia while feeling distinctly modern. Searches for “gummy bear aesthetic” are up 50%, “jelly blush” has climbed 130%, and “jelly candy aesthetic” has grown 100%.

These playful, tactile visuals align with the broader video and [motion trends for 2026](https://elements.envato.com/learn/video-motion-design-trends) — where bouncy animations, liquid motion, and sensory-driven design are defining the year ahead.

**Where it shows up:** Beauty (gel-like makeup, dewy finishes), accessories (phone cases, jewelry), food (probiotic gummies, textured treats), and even wellness products with that signature spring-back quality.

- [Colorful Bubbles (Motion Graphics)](https://app.envato.com/stock-video/eb39d8b4-aba7-4bdc-968e-e4fb8247e635)

### **Glamoratti**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-3.png)

**What it is:** The return of ’80s luxury, reimagined for now. Expect baggier suits with sculpted shoulders, chunky gold jewelry, funnel necks, and tailored drama. Decadence is back, and subtlety is out.

**Why it’s trending:** After years of quiet luxury and minimalism, maximalism is making its entrance. Gen Z and Millennials are driving searches for “80s luxury” (up 225%), “baggy suit” (up 90%), and “chunky belt” (up 65%). Power dressing for a generation that watched **Succession** and thought, “Yes, but bigger.”

**Where it shows up:** Fashion (structured tailoring, bold accessories), events (opulent styling), beauty (glossy lips, sculpted brows), and interiors (brass accents, velvet textures).

**Envato assets to explore:**

- [Luxury Gold Textures](http://app.envato.com/photos/gold+luxury+texture)
- [80s Retro Graphics Pack](https://elements.envato.com/graphics/80s+retro)
- [Elegant Fashion Presentation Templates](https://elements.envato.com/presentation-templates/fashion+luxury)

### **Cool Blue**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-4.png)

**What it is:** A frosty, glacier-inspired color palette showing up across every category. Ice queen energy, but make it wearable, drinkable, and livable.

**Why it’s trending:** The shift away from warm tones continues. Cool blue offers calm and clarity in a chaotic world. Searches for “glacier aesthetic” are up 35%, while icy tones are appearing in everything from nail art and wedding palettes to cocktails and interior design.

**Where it shows up:** Fashion (pale blue coats, ice-toned accessories), beauty (frosty nail art, cool-toned makeup), weddings (blue palettes, winter themes), food and drink (pale blue cocktails), and interiors.

**Envato assets to explore:**

- [Ice Blue Abstract Backgrounds](https://elements.envato.com/photos/ice+blue+abstract)
- [Winter Frost Texture Pack](https://elements.envato.com/graphics/frost+winter+texture)
- [Cool Tone Lightroom Presets](https://elements.envato.com/add-ons/lightroom-presets/cool+blue)

### **Neo Deco**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-5.png)

**What it is:** Art Deco gets a 21st-century remix. Strong geometric patterns, chrome and brass accents, pendant lamps, and leather banquettes. The glamor of the 1920s filtered through contemporary design sensibilities.

**Why it’s trending:** Gen X and Millennials are leading the charge away from beige minimalism toward spaces with personality and presence. Searches for brass aesthetic, antique bar carts, and geometric patterns are all on the rise. After years of pared-back interiors, people want rooms that make a statement.

This shift aligns with broader [graphic design trends for 2026](https://elements.envato.com/learn/graphic-design-trends), where bold geometry and decorative maximalism are making a comeback.

**Where it shows up:** Home décor (statement lighting, metallic finishes), events (sophisticated party styling), graphic design (geometric frames, gold accents), and fashion (structured, geometric accessories).

**Envato assets to explore:**

- [Art Deco Pattern Collection](https://elements.envato.com/graphics/art+deco+pattern)
- [Gold Geometric Frame Graphics](https://elements.envato.com/graphics/gold+geometric+frame)
- [Art Deco Invitation Templates](https://elements.envato.com/graphic-templates/art+deco+invitation)

### **Pen Pals**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Screenshot-2025-12-22-at-6.08.43%E2%80%AFpm-1024x535.png)

**What it is:** A letter-writing renaissance. Snail mail returns with decorated envelopes, wax seals, cute stamps, and handwritten correspondence.

**Why it’s trending:** Digital fatigue is real. Gen Z and Millennials are seeking tactile, intentional forms of connection as an antidote to endless DMs and notifications. Searches for “cute stamps” are up 105%, “snail mail gifts” up 110%, and “handwritten letters” up 45%. In Singapore, Gen Z is four times more likely to engage with pen pal content than the global average.

**Where it shows up:** Stationery (decorated papers, stamp collections), gifting (personalized mail packages), DIY (wax seal kits, calligraphy supplies), and lifestyle content focused on slow living.

**Envato assets to explore:**

- [Vintage Letter Writing Graphics](https://elements.envato.com/graphics/vintage+letter)
- [Wax Seal and Stationery Mockups](https://elements.envato.com/graphic-templates/wax+seal)
- [Handwritten Script Fonts](https://elements.envato.com/fonts/handwritten+script)

[_Discover more rising font trends for 2026 to pair with this aesthetic._](https://elements.envato.com/learn/font-trends-typography-styles)

### **Afrohemian Decor**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-6.png)

**What it is:** A fusion of African and bohemian design influences. Colorful Nigerian textiles, Ethiopian wall art, adire fabrics, handwoven baskets, and natural fiber rugs create spaces that feel rooted in culture and craft.

**Why it’s trending:** The move toward homes with story and soul continues. Searches for “afrobohemian home decor” increased 220%, “adire fabric” is up 130%, and “bamboo beaded curtains” are up 60%. People want interiors that feel personal and rooted in culture rather than generically curated.

**Where it shows up:** Home décor (textiles, wall art, furniture), fashion (print mixing, natural materials), events (culturally rich styling), and hospitality design.

**Envato assets to explore:**

- [African Pattern Graphics](https://elements.envato.com/graphics/african+pattern)
- [Bohemian Interior Stock Photos](https://elements.envato.com/photos/bohemian+interior)
- [Ethnic Textile Backgrounds](https://elements.envato.com/graphics/ethnic+textile)

### **FunHaus**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-7.png)

**What it is:** Circus-inspired home décor. Bold stripes, sculptural silhouettes, and a playful nod to carnival aesthetics, executed with sophistication rather than kitsch.

**Why it’s trending:** Boomers and Millennials are embracing interiors that surprise and delight. “Vintage circus aesthetic” searches are up 70%, “circus interior” is up 130%, and “circus nursery” is up 50%. Playful maximalism with a sense of humor.

**Where it shows up:** Home décor (striped wallpaper, sculptural furniture), nursery design, events (theatrical party styling), and graphic design (bold, playful visuals).

**Envato assets to explore:**

- [Circus Vintage Graphics](https://elements.envato.com/graphics/circus+vintage)
- [Bold Stripe Patterns](https://elements.envato.com/graphics/stripe+pattern+bold)
- [Carnival Event Templates](https://elements.envato.com/graphic-templates/carnival)

### **Cabbage Crush**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-8.png)

**What it is:** The humble cabbage takes center stage. Charred cabbage “steaks,” crispy taco wraps, fermented preparations, and even kimchi cocktails. This overlooked vegetable is having its moment.

**Why it’s trending:** Boomers and Gen X are driving interest in gut-health-friendly fermented foods, while the broader food world is rediscovering cabbage’s versatility and affordability. Searches for “cabbage dumplings,” “golumpki soup,” and “fermented cabbage” are all on the rise.

**Where it shows up:** Food content (recipes, restaurant menus), wellness (probiotic-focused eating), food photography, and culinary branding.

**Envato assets to explore:**

- [Fresh Vegetable Stock Photos](https://elements.envato.com/photos/fresh+vegetables)
- [Food Recipe Video Templates](https://elements.envato.com/video-templates/food+recipe)
- [Organic Food Branding Kits](https://elements.envato.com/graphic-templates/organic+food+branding)

### **Darecations**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-9.png)

**What it is:** Adrenaline-fuelled travel. River rafting, canyoneering, attending major sports events, seeking full-throttle thrills over poolside relaxation.

**Why it’s trending:** Gen Z and Millennials are rejecting passive beach holidays in favour of experiences worth talking about. Searches for “adventure tourism” are up 75%, “river rafting” is up 35%, and “adrenaline rush aesthetic” is climbing.

**Where it shows up:** Travel content (adventure destinations, bucket-list experiences), lifestyle branding, sports and outdoor gear marketing, and event promotions.

**Envato assets to explore:**

- [Adventure Travel Stock Video](https://elements.envato.com/stock-video/adventure+travel)
- [Extreme Sports Photography](https://elements.envato.com/photos/extreme+sports)
- [Travel Vlog Templates](https://elements.envato.com/video-templates/travel+vlog)

### **Mystic Outlands**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-10.png)

**What it is:** Fairytale-meets-fever-dream travel destinations. Scotland’s highlands, the Faroe Islands, Japan’s Arashiyama Bamboo Forest, and Bolivia’s Uyuni Salt Flat. Places that feel like stepping into another world.

**Why it’s trending:** Gen Z and Millennials are searching for “Scotland highlands aesthetic” (up 465%) and “ethereal places” (up 45%). These destinations offer the ultimate escape, with landscapes that seem to belong in a fantasy film. Capturing these otherworldly locations ties into the [photography trends shaping 2026](https://elements.envato.com/learn/photography-trends) — where ethereal, mood-driven imagery is on the rise. This energy connects to broader [filmmaking trends for 2026](https://elements.envato.com/learn/filmmaking-trends), where atmospheric, emotionally immersive visuals are taking center stage.”

**Where it shows up:** Travel content (destination guides, photography), lifestyle branding, tourism marketing, and mood-based visual content.

**Envato assets to explore:**

- [Misty Landscape Photography](https://elements.envato.com/photos/misty+landscape)
- [Ethereal Nature Stock Video](https://elements.envato.com/stock-video/ethereal+nature)
- [Fantasy Travel Presentation Templates](https://elements.envato.com/presentation-templates/travel)

## **Additional trends to watch**

The full Pinterest Predicts 2026 report includes 21 trends. Beyond those detailed above, keep your eye on:

### **Brooched:**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-11.png)

Boomer and Millennial men are driving a brooch revival. Worn on lapels, sleeves, ties, or socks, these heirloom-style accessories turn any outfit into a statement. “Brooch for men’s suit” is up 90%.

### **Glitchy Glam:**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-12.png)

Anti-perfect beauty. Mismatched nails, off-center liner, asymmetric bobs. Symmetry is out.

### **Vamp Romantic:**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-13.png)

Gothic aesthetics with a softer edge. Dark plum lips, smoky eyes, inky manicures without going full subculture.

### **Poetcore:**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-14.png)

Oversized turtlenecks, vintage blazers, messenger satchels. The academic aesthetic undergoes an angsty rebrand, with searches for “the poet aesthetic” increasing by 175%.

### **Khaki Coded:**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-15.png)

Explorer-inspired fashion with desert neutrals, utility shirts, and field jackets. Dressed for an expedition, headed to brunch.

### **Laced Up:**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-16.png)

Lace makes its fashion and beauty debut beyond lingerie. Lace nails are up 215%, lace bandanas up 150%, and lace makeup up 120%.

### **Wilderkind:**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-17.png)

Nature-inspired aesthetics with a delicate touch. Butterfly wing nail art, deer-inspired makeup, and insect jewelry.

### **Operasthetic:**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-18.png)

Dramatic, theatrical styling for weddings and events. Heavy fabrics, red and gold palettes, cabaret-inspired details.

### **Extra Celestial:**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-20.png)

Alien-core goes mainstream. Holographic fabrics, iridescent finishes, and hyperfuturistic design.

### **Throwback Kid:**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-21.png)

Parents recreating their own childhoods for their children. Vintage toys, retro nursery décor, and 1970s-inspired kids’ fashion.

### **Scent Stacking:**

![](https://elements.envato.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/unnamed-22.png)

Building a fragrance wardrobe rather than choosing one signature scent. Layering perfumes and collecting discovery sets.

## **What is Pinterest Predicts, and how does it work?**

The methodology behind Pinterest Predicts is rigorous. The trends team analyzes over two years of search data, encompassing billions of queries, to identify patterns that indicate sustained growth rather than seasonal spikes. They normalize the data to filter out predictable surges, such as the increase in searches around Christmas in December. Machine learning models incorporate predictive scoring, and a visual analysis component ensures trends are captured at their inception point, rather than after they’ve peaked.

The result is a curated list of trends distilled from over 500,000 qualifying search terms. A cross-functional team of researchers, strategists, and designers shapes these into named trends with distinct visual identities. Pinterest also grades predictions annually and publishes a scorecard, feeding learnings back into future methodology.

This year’s report draws on search data comparing activity from September 2024 to August 2025 with the previous 12-month period, capturing patterns from Pinterest’s 600 million monthly users. The trends identified emerge from the collective intent of millions of people, which is precisely what makes them so valuable for businesses trying to anticipate demand.

Pinterest also notes that its trends last nearly twice as long as trends originating elsewhere on the internet and grow faster in the first six months. For brands and creators, this extended runway means more time to build campaigns around emerging interests before they reach saturation.

## **Why these trends matter for creatives**

Pinterest Predicts offers a competitive advantage for anyone creating content, designing products, or planning campaigns.

The 88% accuracy rate represents a real commercial opportunity. When Pinterest predicted the Pickle Fix trend, brands that moved early captured massive engagement and sales. Checkouts on Pinterest Predicts 2025-related content increased 68% year over year. Trends that originate on Pinterest often transition into retail, influence brand campaigns, and shape consumer expectations.

For designers and marketers, these predictions offer a head start on creating relevant work. You can build campaigns around rising interests while they’re still emerging, rather than reacting to trends after they’ve peaked. The extended lifespan of Pinterest trends (lasting nearly twice as long as trends elsewhere) means your trend-aligned content has a longer runway to perform.

Small businesses and freelancers benefit too. Understanding which aesthetics, colors, and themes are gaining traction informs everything from product development to social content to client pitches. Showing a client that “searches for art deco patterns are climbing” with Pinterest data behind it gives your creative recommendation more weight.

The three underlying themes of 2026 (nostalgia as reclamation, identity curation, and grounded escapism) also offer strategic direction. Campaigns that tap into comfort, authenticity, and emotional well-being are likely to resonate more than those that push aspiration or FOMO.For a deeper look at where campaigns are headed, [see our advertising trends for 2026](https://elements.envato.com/learn/advertising-trends).

## **How to apply Pinterest Predicts 2026 trends to your creative work**

**Start with alignment, not adoption.** Scan the full list and identify which predictions naturally connect to your audience, product category, or creative style. A wedding photographer might lean into Operasthetic or Cool Blue. A food brand might explore Cabbage Crush. A fashion client might be interested in Glamoratti or Khaki Coded.

**Mine the search terms for keywords.** Each Pinterest Predicts trend is accompanied by specific rising search terms, which are valuable for SEO, social captions, and paid campaign targeting. If the “glacier aesthetic” is up 35%, that keyword should be included in relevant content.

**Plan content around seasonal moments.** Pinterest Predicts trends will grow throughout the year, but timing matters. A Cabbage Crush recipe post will land differently in autumn than in summer. A Pen Pals gift guide is a perfect fit for Christmas or Valentine’s Day. Map trends to calendar moments for maximum relevance.

**Build assets ahead of demand.** If you’re a stock contributor, template designer or content creator, now is the time to create assets aligned with these trends. Art Deco patterns, gummy textures, adventure travel footage, and circus-inspired graphics will see increased demand as these trends grow. Audio creators should also note how these visual aesthetics translate into [music trends for 2026](https://elements.envato.com/learn/music-trends) — from nostalgic synth sounds to ambient, escapist compositions.

**Use trends as creative springboards.** Pinterest’s own data shows that 42% of users only participate in trends that suit them. The 2026 report emphasizes that trends are opportunities for self-expression, so interpret these predictions through your own lens rather than copying them wholesale.

## **Final thoughts**

Pinterest Predicts 2026 reveals something more interesting than individual aesthetics or color palettes: a collective mood shift toward comfort, identity, and escape, rather than status signaling and FOMO.

The year ahead will be defined by nostalgia remixed (Gimme Gummy, Throwback Kid), bold self-expression (Glamoratti, Brooched, Afrohemian Decor), and grounded forms of escape (Mystic Outlands, Darecations, Cool Blue). For creatives and marketers, the opportunity lies in supporting how people want to feel rather than pushing products.

Explore the full [Pinterest Predicts 2026 report](https://business.pinterest.com/pinterest-predicts/) for detailed visuals and search data. And when you’re ready to bring these trends to life, [Envato’s library of 20+ million creative assets](https://app.envato.com/) has templates, graphics, stock footage, and design tools to help you move fast on what’s next.

### Pinterest Predicts 2026 FAQs

How accurate are Pinterest Predicts trends?

Over the past six years, 88% of Pinterest’s predictions have come true. The platform publishes an annual scorecard to track accuracy and refines its methodology based on results.

Can creatives use Pinterest Predicts for ideas?

Yes. Pinterest Predicts provides specific search terms, visual directions, and demographic insights that can inform content creation, product development, and campaign planning. The trends are supported by data from approximately 600 million users, making them a reliable indicator of emerging demand.

Which trends are easiest for creatives to adopt quickly?

Color-based trends, such as Cool Blue, and aesthetic trends, like Neo Deco or Glamoratti, translate quickly into visual content. Gimme Gummy and FunHaus offer distinct visual directions that work across graphic design, photography, and video. Pen Pals is particularly accessible for stationery, gifting, and lifestyle content.

How does Pinterest decide what’s trending?

interest analyzes billions of searches over two-year periods, comparing year-over-year growth to identify patterns with sustained momentum. The methodology uses normalized data to filter out seasonal fluctuations and machine learning to apply predictive scoring. A cross-functional team then curates qualifying searches into distinct, named trends.

Which industries benefit most from these predictions?

Fashion, beauty, home décor, food and beverage, travel, and events are the categories most directly covered. The underlying themes (nostalgia, identity, escapism) apply broadly to any brand thinking about emotional resonance and cultural relevance.

How often should creatives revisit Pinterest trend data?

Pinterest Predicts drops annually in December, but the platform also publishes seasonal trend reports and maintains a Trends tool for real-time data. Checking in quarterly helps you stay ahead of shifts and identify which predictions are accelerating.
